part1.photoHint: Một người phục vụ đang đặt đĩa thức ăn xuống bàn trước một nhóm bốn người ngồi trong nhà hàng.
options: A waiter is serving food to a group of diners.
The diners are leaving the restaurant.
A chef is chopping vegetables in the kitchen.
The customers are standing in line at the counter.
part1.explanation: Ảnh cho thấy người phục vụ đang mang đồ ăn ra cho nhóm khách. (B), (C) và (D) mô tả hành động không có trong ảnh.

part2.question: Why did the kitchen send out the wrong dish?
options: There was a mix-up with the table numbers.
part2.explanation: Câu hỏi Why cần lý do; (A) giải thích có sự nhầm lẫn số bàn. (B) trả lời Yes cho câu hỏi Wh, (C) nói về giá.

part2.question: Could you remind me what time the restaurant closes?
options: Yes, I close the window every night.
part2.explanation: Người hỏi muốn biết giờ đóng cửa; (A) cho biết giờ. (B) lặp ý 'close' với nghĩa khác, (C) nói về năm khai trương.

part3.transcript:
Woman: Excuse me, I ordered the lemon chicken, but this looks like the fish special.
Man: I'm very sorry, ma'am. There must have been a mix-up with the orders at table nine. I'll take it back right away.
Woman: Thank you. Also, my colleague has a nut allergy. Could you check the ingredients in the chicken sauce?
Man: Of course. The sauce has butter, lemon and herbs, but no nuts. I'll remind the kitchen to keep it away from the dessert station, where we use almonds.
Woman: That would be great. One more thing: we have a meeting at two. How long will the chicken take?
Man: About twelve minutes. As an apology, I'd like to offer you both a free dessert, or a coffee if you prefer.
Woman: Coffee would be perfect. We'll need it for the meeting.

questions.prompt: What problem does the woman mention?
questions.explanation: Cô ấy gọi gà chanh nhưng nhận được món cá; người phục vụ xác nhận có nhầm lẫn đơn hàng.

questions.prompt: What does the woman ask the man to check?
questions.explanation: Cô ấy hỏi 'Could you check the ingredients in the chicken sauce?' vì đồng nghiệp dị ứng với hạt.

questions.prompt: What does the man offer the woman?
questions.explanation: Anh ấy nói 'I'd like to offer you both a free dessert, or a coffee if you prefer'.

part4.transcript: Good afternoon, team. Before we open, a few notes about tonight. First, the weather report predicts heavy rain after seven, so we expect most patrons to arrive early rather than late; please have all stations ready by five thirty. Second, the new autumn menu starts tonight. Guests judge a dish within seconds, so describe each special clearly: the pumpkin soup has a smoky flavor from roasted peppers, and the lamb comes with a basic herb sauce that we can make without garlic on request. Third, our owner has asked us to excite returning guests with something new, so every table will receive a small tasting spoon of the new chestnut dessert. Finally, a reminder: a food inspector may visit randomly this month. Do not forget to wash your hands between tasks, and keep the allergy list beside the pass at all times. Thanks, everyone. Let's have a great evening.

questions.prompt: Who most likely is the speaker?
questions.explanation: Người nói hướng dẫn nhân viên trước giờ mở cửa về thực đơn, quy định vệ sinh và khách, nên là quản lý nhà hàng.

questions.prompt: Why does the speaker expect guests to arrive early?
options: Rain is expected later in the evening
questions.explanation: 'the weather report predicts heavy rain after seven, so we expect most patrons to arrive early'.

options: A sample of a new dessert
questions.explanation: 'every table will receive a small tasting spoon of the new chestnut dessert'.

part5.prompt: The chef's new tasting menu has _____ food critics all over the region.
part5.explanation: 'has' + quá khứ phân từ tạo thì hiện tại hoàn thành: 'has excited'.

part5.prompt: The soup has a rich _____ because it is cooked slowly for six hours.
part5.explanation: Sau 'a rich' cần danh từ: 'flavor' (hương vị).

part5.prompt: It is hard to _____ how many guests will come on a rainy evening.
part5.explanation: Sau 'to' cần động từ nguyên mẫu: 'predict'.

part5.prompt: Staff should _____ a cleaning checklist at the end of every shift.
part5.explanation: Sau 'should' cần động từ nguyên mẫu: 'complete'.

part5.prompt: The host _____ selects a table to receive a free appetizer each night.
part5.explanation: Cần trạng từ bổ nghĩa cho động từ 'selects': 'randomly'.

part5.prompt: Loyal _____ of the cafe receive a discount card after ten visits.
part5.explanation: Động từ 'receive' ở số nhiều nên chủ ngữ phải là danh từ số nhiều: 'patrons'. 'patronage' là danh từ không đếm được, không hợp.

part6.passage:
Dear Ms. Whitfield,

Thank you for your email about your dinner at Juniper Grill last Saturday. I am sorry that a ___ at our front desk meant your group waited for its table. We have spoken with the evening staff and have ___ them to confirm every reservation twice. Please also accept our apology for the salad: our kitchen should never ___ to ask about allergies, and we have added a written question to every order slip. I would like to invite you back for a free meal for four. Please call me at 555-0142 to arrange a date.

Sincerely,
Owen Castellano
General Manager

questions.explanation: Sau 'a' cần danh từ chỉ sự nhầm lẫn khiến khách phải chờ bàn: 'mix-up'.
'have ___ them' là thì hiện tại hoàn thành, cần quá khứ phân từ: 'reminded'.
Sau 'should never' cần động từ nguyên mẫu: 'forget'.

part7.passage:
RIVERBEND KITCHEN
A note to our patrons

Starting on March 1, Riverbend Kitchen will make three changes based on the 412 feedback cards you completed last winter.

1. A new seasonal menu. Many of you told us that the menu had not changed in two years. From March, the chef will replace one third of the dishes every season and list the main ingredients of each dish, so that guests with allergies no longer need to ask.

2. Shorter waits at lunch. On weekdays, the basic lunch set (soup, main dish and coffee) will be served within fifteen minutes of ordering, or the coffee is free. We predict that this will cut the average lunch visit from 55 to 40 minutes.

3. Fewer booking errors. Several cards mentioned a mix-up with reservations. From now on, our host will call every party on the morning of the booking to remind them of the time and confirm the number of guests.

Each month we will randomly choose one completed card and give its writer a dinner for two. Thank you for helping us improve. We hope the new flavors excite you as much as they excite our kitchen team.

Grace Oyelaran, Owner

options: To explain changes made after customer feedback
To apologize for a price increase
questions.explanation: Thông báo nêu ba thay đổi 'based on the 412 feedback cards you completed last winter'.

questions.prompt: What will appear on the new menu?
options: The main ingredients of each dish
questions.explanation: Mục 1: bếp trưởng sẽ 'list the main ingredients of each dish on the menu'.

questions.prompt: What happens if a weekday lunch set takes more than fifteen minutes?
options: The guest can leave without paying
questions.explanation: Mục 2: suất ăn trưa được phục vụ trong mười lăm phút, 'or the coffee is free'.

options: By using a new booking website
By calling guests on the day of their booking
By asking guests to pay a deposit
questions.explanation: Mục 3: người tiếp đón sẽ gọi cho mỗi nhóm khách vào buổi sáng ngày đặt bàn để nhắc giờ và xác nhận số khách.

questions.prompt: What can a patron win each month?
options: A free lunch set for a month
questions.explanation: 'Each month we will randomly choose one completed card and give its writer a dinner for two.'
